title: pkmjson product family
description: One sealed Pokémon TCG product and its contents, released in one or more languages.

id.description: Stable pkmjson id of the product family, without language. Never reused.

region.description: Which TCGdex tree the set belongs to. Japanese and other Asian products are separate families.

set.description: TCGdex set id, for example sv08 or SV8.

name.description: The product's English name, for people browsing the files.

identifiers.description: Ids that name the product in every language. Cardmarket sells every language of a sealed product under one product id and records the language on each offer.

contentsStatus.description: complete: every item in the box is listed. partial: some contents are missing, for example the random cards of a booster pack.

releases.description: One entry per language the product was sold in.

pool.description: Only on booster_pack and sleeved_booster_pack. The sets whose cards the pack can hold, at random: any card of these sets, in the release's language, as TCGdex lists each set. It is random, so it says nothing about rarity slots or odds. It does not change contentsStatus.

poolSet.description: One TCGdex set a booster pack can draw from.

set.description: TCGdex set id, the same codes families use in `set`.

region.description: The set's TCGdex tree. Defaults to the family's region.

sealedItem.description: Another pkmjson product inside this one. It resolves to the same language as the release that holds it.

cardItem.description: One printing, pinned by TCGdex card id and variant id. variantId is the same in every language; a release resolves the card in its own language. tcgplayerProductId is TCGplayer's single-card product for that printing, which TCGplayer lists in English only.

otherItem.description: Anything that is not a card or a product: sleeves, dice, code cards, Energy cards.

name.description: The product's name as sold in this language.

identifiers.description: Ids of this language's release. TCGplayer lists each language as its own product.

contents.description: Replaces the family's contents for this language only, when this release differs.

sources.description: Pages that state this release's contents or name.
